verdict.rationale: Apify documents support for headless-browser tooling, including its own Crawlee browser automation library alongside Playwright, Puppeteer and Selenium. That implies Actors can render JavaScript-heavy pages, but no evidence explicitly shows SPA rendering or returning fully rendered HTML. Missing for 10: explicit docs on JS/SPA rendering and wait conditions, a documented way to return the fully rendered HTML output, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can render JavaScript-heavy single-page applications and get the fully rendered HTML

citations.quote: Apify works great with both Python and JavaScript, as well as Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy, and Crawlee - our own web crawling and browser automation library.
